title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; update docs site
author: Maya Thompson
release_notes: Adds RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to examples repo; updates docs site navigation and examples for SDK v2 API. Includes sample RAG YAML templates, Python/TS quickstarts, and a docs site guide for tool calling.
description: Context: Provide first-party RAG agent templates and canonical tool-calling quickstarts for customers and internal teams. Motivation: many users ask for concrete templates and end-to-end examples (indexing -> retriever -> agent tool calls) that work with the latest SDK changes. This PR bundles: 1) a set of RAG agent YAML templates for common patterns (qa-with-sources, summarization, multi-step tool-calling), 2) runnable quickstarts in Python and TypeScript demonstrating embedding, vector store setup, and agent tool calling, 3) docs site updates: new docs pages, nav entries, and example snippets. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG YAML templates in redwood-examples/quickstarts - [x] Add runnable Python quickstart that uses SDK v2 client and tool interface - [x] Add TypeScript quickstart and tsconfig for examples - [x] Docs site pages and nav updated under /docs/agents/rag - [x] Add CI smoke tests for examples that run in containerized env - [x] Address reviewer feedback and fix API rename and lint errors. Testing and CI: initial CI run reported a flaky example e2e test (index creation timeout) which was mitigated by increasing the test timeout and adding a retry in the smoke harness; subsequent CI run passed. Related work: ENG-1250 (RAG templates), PM-342 (quickstart content), SUP-887 (customer ask).
commits: Add initial RAG templates and Python quickstart
Add TypeScript quickstart and example fixture
Docs: add agent RAG docs and navigation entries
Fix: update SDK v2 client usage (client.chat -> client.createChat) and adapt examples
CI: bump example test timeout and add retry
review_comments: Ethan Li requested clearer separation between retriever setup and agent orchestration and suggested adding a minimal example without tool calls for faster onboarding.
Maya responded that a simple retriever-only quickstart was added and included a note about cost and latency tradeoffs.
Ava flagged an SDK API rename (client.chat -> client.createChat) and asked to update all examples accordingly; author updated examples and added a compatibility note for older SDKs.
Diego asked for an e2e smoke test to catch index-creation timeouts; added a retry and extended timeout in CI harness.
Final approval comment: 'Looks good to me — docs are clear and examples runnable. Small nits captured in follow-up issue ENG-1289.' — Ethan Li
